purpose: Teach: 乗り込む/やって来る/得よ/上質/ニュースレター/上乗せ/不可避/初旬

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、新会議室に、絶対、乗り込む覚悟で、絶対、新企画、進めましょうね
lines.en: Let's approach this new project with real commitment — we're going into that conference room ready to make it happen.
lines.style: Energized and direct. Forward momentum on 'approach.' Slight emphasis on 'ready' to signal resolve. Confident pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone already moving.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様、本気で、絶対、定期的に、絶対、やって来る、絶対、お得意様、絶対、感謝、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our valued clients come back regularly, and we genuinely appreciate their loyalty.
lines.style: Warm agreement. Measured pace — slightly slower to land gratitude. Slight vocal lift on 'valued' and 'appreciate' to show sincerity. Professional but personal.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 利益を、本気で、絶対、得ようとしながらも、絶対、お客様、第一を、絶対、心がけましょうね
lines.en: We'll keep pursuing profit, but let's stay centered on putting our clients first — that's what matters most.
lines.style: Thoughtful but resolute. Slight pause before 'clients first' — the pivot point. Quieter emphasis on the priority shift. Steady, almost coaching tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。上質な、本気で、絶対、商品、絶対、お客様、絶対、ご好評、いただいております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The high-quality products we're offering have gotten great feedback from our clients, and we're truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Attentive and affirming. Warmth on 'high-quality' and 'grateful.' Moderate pace with small breath pause before 'grateful' — letting it land. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内、本気で、絶対、ニュースレター、絶対、定期発行を、絶対、進めましょうね
lines.en: So let's move forward with regular internal newsletters — keep everyone in the loop.
lines.style: Directive but collaborative. Clear emphasis on 'regular' — establishing rhythm. Brisk but not rushed. Slight uplift at end to invite buy-in.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格に、本気で、絶対、上乗せ、絶対、慎重に、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're being careful and thoughtful about any price adjustments — we want to get that right.
lines.style: Careful, measured tone. Emphasis on 'careful' and 'thoughtful' — showing deliberation. Slightly slower pace. Reassuring, like a promise to think this through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 時代の変化、本気で、絶対、不可避、絶対、ですから、絶対、柔軟に、絶対、対応しましょう
lines.en: The way the world's changing is inevitable, so we need to stay flexible and adapt to what comes.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly philosophical. Quiet opening before 'changing' — acknowledging weight. Steady tempo. Shift to lighter, more agile tone on 'flexible and adapt.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新年度初旬、本気で、絶対、新人研修を、絶対、実施、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'll be running new employee training right at the start of the fiscal year, and we appreciate your support with that.
lines.style: Committed and reassuring. Steady, professional pace. Slight emphasis on 'right at the start' — showing preparation. Warm close on gratitude, like a genuine thank you.
